description.en: The RCA (phono) plug class: a Ø3.25 mm centre pin standing 8 mm beyond an outer sleeve Ø9 mm across, mating an RCA jack.
description.es: La clase de plug RCA: un pin central de Ø3.25 mm que sobresale 8 mm de una manga exterior de Ø9 mm, que acopla con un jack RCA.
description.fr: La classe de fiche RCA (Cinch) : une broche centrale de Ø3,25 mm qui dépasse de 8 mm d'un manchon extérieur de Ø9 mm, qui s'accouple à une embase RCA.
description.pt: A classe de plugue RCA: um pino central de Ø3,25 mm que sobressai 8 mm de uma manga exterior de Ø9 mm, que acopla num jack RCA.

sources.title: Same Sky RCP-02 RCA plug (rev 1.04) datasheet
sources.supports: centre pin Ø3.25 +0/−0.15, standing 8 ±0.5 beyond the outer sleeve; outer sleeve Ø9, 5.5 long

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the outer sleeve's front rim, on the plug's axis. +z runs along the centre pin to its tip at z = 8; the body and cable lie at z < 0. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the plug is round.

interfaces.note: Male: the centre pin enters a jack's centre contact. A mate puts the sleeve rim on the jack's front face, a convention.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: One maker's current RCA plug drawing; its discontinued predecessor drew the same Ø9.0 sleeve and a Ø3.2 pin. The sleeve's inside diameter, which grips the jack, is not printed, so the fit is the jack's outer contact Ø8.3.

solids.note: the centre pin beyond the sleeve

envelope.note: The outer sleeve and the protruding pin; the body behind the sleeve has no cited size and is not modelled.
